relation_to_item_6: The port-normalization operator K is the lower-row/response-trace shadow of the full entrywise block defect. Full item 6 implies K=0 and hence item 7, but item 7 only requires K to annihilate the Evans Xi-jet module modulo tau.
disposition: The independent conservative Evans problem has been reduced exactly to a fixed normalization/placement defect. Canonical Stokes cancellation supplies the reference codiagonal; no analytic response term remains to be invented. Proving Xi divisibility still requires the old conservative port matrices or an owner theorem identifying them with the canonical codiagonal.
